summary: Husband of Carmela Cicco and father of Maria Colosimo, the wife of Vincenzo Ferlaino; John's 6th-great-grandfather.
bio: Andrea Colosimo married Carmela Cicco. Their daughter Maria Colosimo, who died in 1845, married Vincenzo Ferlaino, and through her Andrea is John's 6th-great-grandfather.
